description: The voice helper's frames (contract: voice/helper/src/frames.rs): a u32 little-endian length of what follows, a kind byte (0 JSON, 1 audio), the payload. Read by cargo test (parity/tests/vectors.rs, against the parity fake's codec) and by bun test (server/src/voice/voice-frames.vectors.test.ts, against encodeFrame and FrameReader).

frames.name: audio of session 7: its u32 id, then S16LE samples
an empty payload is a frame of length 1

invalid.name: a length past the 16 MiB cap
